Datum B = rear slot centre line. 12 pads 1.40 long (12-1.40) from datum B rearward (centre 0.70 behind B). x: A1/B12, A12/B1 at +-3.50 (7.00) and A4/B9, A9/B4 at +-2.50 (2-1.00), 0.80 wide (4-0.80); 8 pads 0.30 wide (8-0.30) at pitch 0.50 (7-0.50), +-0.25..+-1.75, order B8, A5, B7, A6, A7, B6, A8, B5 (p.1 tail labels). Pegs 2X dia 0.60, at x +-3.50 (1.15 inside the rear slots), 0.47 ahead of B: drawn without copper, taken as NPTH. Rear shell slots x +-4.65 (9.30): slot 0.60 x 1.20, copper 0.90 x 1.30. Front shell slots x +-5.92 (11.84), 4.32 ahead of B: slot 0.60 x 1.50, copper 0.90 x 1.60 (4-0.60 / 4-0.90). BOARD CUT-OUT (not in this footprint): 9.14 wide, from about 0.9 ahead of B to the PCB edge. Product edge 5.85 ahead of the front slots. Body 9.58 x 11.07 (p.1 top view), front face at the product edge (10.17 ahead of B). The 2-0.55 dimension on the right side could not be tied to a feature and is not used.

footprints.description: Amphenol 12401951 USB-C receptacle, vertical SMT L=12mm, 24 SMD pads + 6 slotted shell / mid-plate legs
footprints.note: 12401951.pdf p.2 Recommended PCB layout (top view, oriented like the p.1 mating-face view: row A at top with A1 left, B12 below A1), tolerance +-0.05. Pads 24X 0.25 wide, 12X from 1.60 to 3.00 off the centre line (length 1.40, centre 2.30), pitch 0.50 (0.50X11=5.50), both rows centred and aligned. Corner shell slots at x +-4.10 (8.20), y +-3.07 (2X 6.14): horizontal slot 1.30 x 0.80, copper 1.70 x 1.20. Mid-plate slots at x +-3.775 (7.55), y 0: slot 0.95 x 0.55, copper 1.35 x 0.95. Body 9.15 x 6.54 (keep-out p.2, face view p.1).

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402012 USB-C 2.0 receptacle, top mount SMT CH=1.68, 12 SMD pads + 4 slotted shell legs + 2 NPTH pegs
footprints.note: 12402012-10.pdf p.2 Recommended PCB layout (top view; drawn mating face down at product edge, rotated 180 deg here), tolerance +-0.05. Datum = front slot centre line. Product (front) edge 2.60 ahead of datum. Body 8.94 x 7.35 (p.1 top view), front face at the product edge.

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402032 USB-C receptacle, vertical double-row SMT L=6.50mm, 24 SMD pads + 4 slotted shell legs + 2 NPTH pegs
footprints.note: 12402032.pdf p.2 Recommended P.C.B. layout (T 1.00 mm; taken as top view, A1 top-left like the p.1 mating-face view), tolerance +-0.127 unless stated. Shell slots at 1.35 and 6.15 (2X), y +-2.15: horizontal slot 1.00 x 0.60, copper 1.40 x 1.00. Body 8.94 x 3.16 (p.1 housing; the 11.00 x 7.00 outline is the pick-up cap).

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402054 USB-C 2.0 receptacle, right-angle double-DIP standing on edge, 14 plated holes + 4 slotted shell legs
footprints.note: 12402054.pdf p.2 Recommended PCB layout (top view; drawn mating face down toward the PCB edge, rotated 180 deg here), tolerance +-0.05. 14X hole dia 0.40, pad dia 0.60, two columns 0.78 apart, each 1.04 in from the shell slot columns (slots 2.86 apart). Column A (A1, A4, A5, A6, A7, A9, A12) pitch 0.90, A1 to A12 5.40; column B (B12, B9, B7, B6, B5, B4, B1) pitch 0.90, offset 0.45 toward the mating face (B12 0.45 ahead of A1, B1 to B12 5.40). Shell slots 4X: slot 0.60 x 1.60, copper 1.90 long (copper width 0.90 = 0.60 + 2 x 0.15 ring from the length dims); front pair in line with A1, rear pair 4.80 behind (2X4.80). PCB edge 5.05 ahead of A1; connector (front) edge 7.60 ahead of B12. Body 3.16 x 14.55 (p.1 top view 3.16 thick, 14.55 long), front face at the connector edge.

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402056 USB4 Type-C receptacle, top mount CH=1.57, 24 SMD pads + 6 slotted shell legs + 2 NPTH pegs
footprints.note: c12402056.pdf p.2 Recommended PCB layout (top view, board edge down; rotated 180 deg here), tolerance +-0.05. Datum = peg line: 2X dia 0.67 at +-3.60 (7.20), plain circles, taken as NPTH. Pads 12X 0.27 wide, pitch 0.50: row A A1 0.975 from the left peg (x -2.625) to A12 +2.875, 0.90 long from 2.25 to 3.15 behind datum; row B B12 -2.875 to B1 +2.625 (0.25 offset), 0.80 long from 0.70 to 1.50 behind datum (same signal lands as 12402143). Rear shell slots x +-4.32 (8.64), 2.00 behind datum: slot 0.70 x 1.90, copper 1.10 x 2.30. Front slots 3.05 ahead of datum: inner pair x +-4.32 slot 0.70 x 2.00 copper 1.30 x 2.60; outer pair x +-6.42 (12.84) slot 0.85 x 1.80 copper 1.45 x 2.40. A cross-hatched area 7.80 min wide from the peg line to the board edge (4.85 ahead of datum) is not explained on the drawing; the p.1 title says top mount and the mounting-condition view shows the connector on top of the board overhanging its edge by 1.30, so it is read as a keep-out, not a cut-out. Body 8.94 x 9.17 (p.1 top view); front face 6.20 ahead of the peg line (p.1 bottom view).

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402072 USB4 Type-C receptacle, sink mount CH=-0.10, 24 SMD pads + 8 slotted shell legs + 2 NPTH (needs board cut-out)
footprints.note: c12402072.pdf p.2 Recommended PCB layout (top view, PCB edge down; rotated 180 deg here), tolerance +-0.05. Datums: X/Y = centre of the round NPTH dia 0.85; second NPTH oval 1.15 x 0.85 (horizontal) at X+8.50. Connector centre line X+4.25 (1.625 + 2.625; cut-out 2x4.70 about it). Pads 24X 0.27 wide, pitch 0.50: row A A1 X+1.625 .. A12 X+7.125, 0.90 long from 1.70 to 0.80 behind Y; row B B12 X+1.375 .. B1 X+6.875 (0.25 offset), 0.80 long from 0.05 behind to 0.75 ahead of Y. Shell slots (all 0.75 wide, copper (1.35) wide): rear pair horizontal at X-0.15 and X+8.65, 1.625 behind Y, slot 1.50 copper (2.10); side columns at X-2.00 and X+10.50: middle pair 0.10 ahead of Y slot 1.50 copper (2.10), then pairs at 3.15 and 5.85 ahead of Y slot 1.70 copper (2.30). BOARD CUT-OUT (not in this footprint): 9.40 wide (2x4.70) about the centre line, starting about 1.0 ahead of Y with R0.50 notches, open to the PCB edge 7.50 ahead of Y; slot copper outlines carry R0.375/R0.675 keep-outs. Body 8.94 x 10.35 (p.1); front face 1.10 beyond the PCB edge (mounting condition), so 8.60 ahead of Y, rear 1.75 behind.

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402136 USB-C receptacle, mid mount CH=0.40 IP68, 24 SMD pads + 4 slotted shell legs + 2 plated slotted pegs (needs board cut-out)

Rear shell slots 10.05 apart, 0.40 ahead of datum: slot 0.60 x 1.30, copper 1.00 x 1.70. Front shell slots 11.30 apart, 2.60 ahead: slot 0.60 x 1.70, copper 1.20 x 2.30. Body 9.74 x 8.14 (p.1 top view: 6.84 housing + 1.30 tongue past the gasket; rear face about 0.28 behind datum, scaled from the p.1 bottom view).

footprints.description: Amphenol 12402073 USB4 Type-C receptacle, 24 SMD pads + 6 slotted shell legs + 2 NPTH pegs

Pads 12x0.27 wide; A row (A1-A12) 0.90 long, outer edge 3.15 behind datum (centre 2.70); B row (B1-B12) 0.80 long, outer edge 1.50 behind datum (centre 1.10). footprints.description: Amphenol 12402075 USB4 Type-C mid-mount receptacle, 24 SMD pads + 8 slotted shell legs

footprints.description: IV-9 / IV-16 numitron tube, 9 wire leads on a 7.35 mm circle, 11 mm envelope

Top view (component side): the sheet numbers leads clockwise from the lead side, so counter-clockwise here; the key gap is put at the rear (top) and the middle lead at the front (bottom), as on the IN-14: the sheets do not say which way the display faces

footprints.description: IV-6 VFD tube, 11 wire leads on a 7.5 mm circle (12 positions), 13 mm envelope
footprints.note: IV-6 passport, datasheets/vfd/iv-6.pdf: 12 positions numbered clockwise from the lead side, the 12th lead missing (the key); envelope dia 13 max. No lead circle is dimensioned: dia 7.5 and 30deg pitch from an open footprint (jh1995/KiCad-libs IV-6.kicad_mod). Lead dia not given: 0.5 assumed (R5: drill 0.75, pad 1.5). Top view (component side): the sheet numbers leads clockwise from the lead side, so counter-clockwise here; the key gap is put at the rear (top) and the middle lead at the front (bottom), as on the IN-14: the sheets do not say which way the display faces

footprints.description: IV-11 VFD tube, 11 wire leads on a 12 mm circle (12 positions), 22.5 mm envelope

Top view (component side): the sheet numbers leads clockwise from the lead side, so counter-clockwise here; the key gap is put at the rear (top) and the middle lead at the front (bottom), as on the IN-14: the sheets do not say which way the display faces

footprints.description: IV-12 VFD tube, 10 pins on an 11.9 mm circle, 22.5 mm envelope
footprints.note: IV-12 outline in the reference book page, datasheets/vfd/iv-11_iv-12-refbook-p191.pdf: 10 rigid pins dia 1 on dia 11.9, 9 x 34deg = 306deg, a 54deg gap between 10 and 1; envelope dia 22.5 (R5: drill 1.3, pad 2.0). Top view (component side): the sheet numbers leads clockwise from the lead side, so counter-clockwise here; the key gap is put at the rear (top) and the middle lead at the front (bottom), as on the IN-14: the sheets do not say which way the display faces. Holes fit the tube's own pins; socket pins need a larger drill

footprints.description: IV-18 VFD tube, 22 wire leads on a 14.4 mm circle at one end, 19 mm envelope
footprints.note: No factory drawing found: 22 leads evenly spaced on a dia 14.4 circle, lead 7 towards the digits' face, from an open footprint (jh1995/KiCad-libs IV-18.kicad_mod) and tube-tester.com's drawing, datasheets/vfd/iv-18.pdf; envelope dia 19, 108 mm long (reference page, datasheets/vfd/iv-18-sparktube.jpg). Lead dia not given: 0.5 assumed (R5: drill 0.75, pad 1.5). The pads are the tube seen end-on (it stands on this board, or lies along the main board with its leads dressed to the pads); lead 7 at the bottom, numbered counter-clockwise from above

footprints.description: 14-pin DIP on a 2.5 mm pitch (Soviet package 201.14), 7.5 mm row spacing
footprints.note: K155IE2 reference sheet, datasheets/nixie/k155ie2.pdf: package 201.14, 2.5 mm pitch, 7.5 mm row spacing; no lead or body dimensions given: pads, drill and body as PDIP-14 (R5)

footprints.description: IN-19 nixie tube, 13 wire leads on a 9 mm circle (14 positions), 19 mm envelope
footprints.note: IN-19A/B/V passport, datasheets/nixie/in-19a_in-19b_in-19v.pdf: 14 positions counted from the indicator arrow, lead 1 cut off (it keeps its pad). The passport does not dimension the lead circle: dia 9 and lead dia 0.5 from tube-tester.com's IN-19A outline (an open footprint, nixies-us-IN-19, uses dia 8.4); 14 x 25.71deg (R5: drill 0.75, pad 1.5). Top view (component side): the sheet numbers leads clockwise from the lead side, so counter-clockwise here; position 1 at the front (bottom), lead 8 (the anode) at the rear

footprints.description: IN-7 nixie tube (end view), 14 pins (RSh31 base) on an 18 mm circle, 31 mm envelope
footprints.note: RSh31 base drawing, datasheets/nixie/russian_bases.pdf: 14 pins dia 1 (R5: drill 1.3, pad 2.0) on dia 18, 13 x 24deg30' from pin 1 to pin 14 (a 41deg30' gap); the IN-7's exhaust tip under the base is dia 7.5 (8.0 non-plated hole at the centre); envelope dia 31 (reference book, datasheets/nixie/russian_tubes_02.pdf p.3). Top view (component side): the sheet numbers leads clockwise from the lead side, so counter-clockwise here; pin 7 at the bottom, as tube-tester.com gives for the IN-4 on the same base: the book does not say which pin is at the foot of the symbol. Holes fit the tube's own pins; socket pins need a larger drill

footprints.description: IN-1 nixie tube (end view), 11 pins (RSh19 base) on a 27 mm circle, 35 mm base
footprints.note: RSh19 base drawing, datasheets/nixie/russian_bases.pdf: 11 pins dia 2.4 (R5: drill 2.65, pad 3.35) equally spaced (32deg44') on dia 27, a keyed spigot dia 8 at the centre (8.5 non-plated hole; its 2.3 mm key, between pins 11 and 1, needs a notch filed in the hole); base dia 35. Top view (component side): the sheet numbers leads clockwise from the lead side, so counter-clockwise here; the key at the bottom: neither the passport (datasheets/nixie/in-1.pdf) nor the book says which pin is at the foot of the numeral. Holes fit the tube's own pins; socket pins need a larger drill

footprints.description: Z573M nixie tube, 13 wire leads on a 9.53 mm circle (14 positions), 19 mm envelope

footprints.description: TO-220 5-lead formed (bent) leads, TI NEB0005B, lying flat, 10.29 x 14.99 mm body with tab, 1.70 mm pitch, rows 4.115 apart
footprints.note: TI NEB0005B (TO-220, TA05B Rev A) mechanical data (R5, no board layout), datasheets/regulator/ti/lm2576.pdf p.40 (LM2576T-5.0/LF02): lead pitch 0.057-0.077 in (1.45-1.96) -> 1.70 (0.067 in); lead width 0.030-0.040 in (0.76-1.02) mid 0.89, thickness 0.38 -> drill 0.89+0.25 = 1.14 -> 1.15, round pad 1.15+0.7 = 1.85; the leads leave the body flat and bend down into the board: vertical parts of leads 1, 3, 5 end 18.67 mid (18.42-18.92) and of leads 2, 4 end 14.555 mid (14.30-14.81) from the tab screw-hole centre line (outer lead faces, so lead centres are 0.19 = half the 0.38 thickness nearer: 18.48 and 14.365), 4.115 apart; the hole centre is 2.795 mid (2.54-3.05) from the tab edge; tab 6.35 mid (6.10-6.60) + body 8.635 mid (8.38-8.89) = 14.985 long (y), width 10.285 mid (10.03-10.54) -> 10.29 (x); body centre is 7.4925 from the tab edge so pad rows y = 2.795+18.48-7.4925 = +13.7825 (pins 1, 3, 5) and 2.795+14.365-7.4925 = +9.6675 (pins 2, 4); tab behind (-y), pin 1 at the left (drawing top view has the tab left and pin 1 at the bottom; turned 90 degrees clockwise). The tab screw hole (3.78-3.89) is not drawn. Not the straight-lead KC0005A nor the staggered NDH0005D

footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 1.6 x 1.0 mm body, Abracon ABS05 land pattern

ECS ECX-16 / ECX-16R / ECX-16Q Figure 2 (ecx-16.pdf p.1) give the same pads (1.1 centre to centre). Body 1.6 x 1.0. Drawing marks #1 on the chamfered terminal of the bottom view; pad 1 left.

footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 2.0 x 1.2 mm body, Abracon ABS06 land pattern

footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 6.0 x 3.5 mm body, Abracon ABM7

Body 6.00 x 3.50. Pad 1 left (the bottom view puts PIN 1 on the right, the top view on the left).

footprints.description: Abracon AB26T 2.1 x 6.2 mm cylinder crystal, 2 leads, 0.8 mm lead spacing
footprints.note: Abracon AB26T outline drawing (AB26T.pdf p.1): body dia 2.1 max (0.083 in), lead dia 0.26 (0.010 in), lead spacing 0.8 (0.031 in). Datasheet gives lead spacing and lead diameter, no PCB land pattern: R8 radial, span = lead spacing. R8 pad (hole + 0.6) would overlap at this spacing, so pad = span - 0.1 (round, 0.1 mm copper gap), drill = min(lead + 0.3, pad - 0.2), at least lead + 0.05. Body = round can seen from above (upright mount). Arithmetic: pad 0.8 - 0.1 = 0.7; drill min(0.26 + 0.3 = 0.56, 0.7 - 0.2 = 0.5) = 0.5.

footprints.description: Abracon HC-49/U and HC-49/US crystal, 11.5 x 5.0 mm can, 2 leads, 4.88 mm lead spacing
footprints.note: Abracon HC49/U outline (ab.pdf p.3) and ABL HC49/US mechanical dimensions (ABL.pdf p.4; identical lead data): body 0.453 in (11.5) x 0.20 in (5.0) max, lead dia 0.018 in (0.457), lead spacing 0.192 +-0.008 in (4.88 +-0.20, mid 4.88). No land pattern printed: R8 hole = 0.457 + 0.3 = 0.757 -> 0.76, pad = 0.76 + 0.6 = 1.36 (round); 4.88 - 1.36 = 3.52 mm between pads. Shared by the HC-49/US line (same pads).

footprints.description: 3-terminal ceramic resonator, 2.5 x 2.0 mm body: three 0.5 x 0.8 pads at each end of the terminals, 1.0 mm pitch, pins 1-3 left to right (a pad at the top and the bottom of each)
footprints.note: Abracon AWSCR-CW 'Recommended Land Pattern' (datasheets/crystal/abracon/AWSCR_CW.pdf p.2): pad width 0.5, pitch 1.0, pad centre lines 2.0+-0.2 apart; that drawing gives no pad length, 0.8 taken from the identical ECS-HFR-B Figure 2 land pattern (datasheets/crystal/ecs/ecs_HFR_B.pdf p.1: 0.5 wide, 0.8 long, centres 2.0 apart, 1.0 pitch). Hand check: x = -1.0, 0, +1.0 (pitch 1.0); y = +-2.0/2 = +-1.0; each pad 0.5 x 0.8 spans y 0.6..1.4 (body edge at 1.0, pad runs 0.4 past it and 0.4 under it); pad gap in x = 1.0-0.5 = 0.5 (matches the drawing's 0.5 gaps, overall 3x0.5+2x0.5 = 2.5). Each pin has two pads (top and bottom), the terminal runs under the body between them. Pin numbering 1-2-3 left to right as the datasheet's pin table (1 X1/In, 2 GND, 3 X2/Out). Body 2.5 x 2.0.

footprints.description: 3-terminal ceramic resonator, 3.2 x 1.3 mm body: three 0.4 x 2.0 pads, 1.2 mm pitch
footprints.note: Abracon AWSCR-CELA 'Recommended Land Pattern' (datasheets/crystal/abracon/AWSCR-CELA.pdf p.4; AWSCR-CELB.pdf p.4 is the same drawing); equal to ECS-CTE Figure 2 Suggested Land Pattern (datasheets/crystal/ecs/ECS-CTE.pdf p.1). Hand check: pads 0.4 wide x 2.0 (+-0.2) long, centres 1.2 apart -> x = -1.2, 0, +1.2; gap = 1.2-0.4 = 0.8; outer edge = 1.2+0.2 = 1.4 < body half 1.6 (terminals 0.4 wide at 1.2 pitch with 0.4 from the end, outline: 1.2+0.2+0.2 = 1.6 ok). Pad length 2.0 vs body height 1.3: 0.35 past the body each side. Pins 1 Input, 2 Ground, 3 Output left to right.

footprints.description: 3-terminal ceramic resonator, 3.7 x 3.1 mm body: 0.7 x 4.1 outer pads, 1.0 x 4.1 middle pad, 1.5 mm pitch
footprints.note: Abracon AWSCR-CV 'Recommended Land Pattern' (datasheets/crystal/abracon/AWSCR_CV.pdf p.2: 0.7 outer, 1.0 middle, 1.5 centre to centre, 4.1 long); equal to ECS-CR2-B Figure 3 / table T1 1.0 (middle width), T2 0.7 (outer width), T3 1.5 (pitch), W1 4.1 (datasheets/crystal/ecs/ecs_cr2_b.pdf p.1). Hand check: outer pads x = +-1.5, 0.7 wide -> span 1.15..1.85 = body edge 3.7/2 = 1.85 minus the 0.7 terminal; middle pad 1.0 wide -> -0.5..0.5; gap between pads = 1.15-0.5 = 0.65. Pins 1, 2 (ground), 3 left to right. The drawings are not to scale (the Abracon outer pads are drawn wider); the printed dimensions are used.

footprints.description: 3-terminal ceramic resonator, 6.0 x 3.0 mm body: 1.7 x 4.0 outer pads, 1.5 x 4.0 middle pad, 2.5 mm pitch
footprints.note: Abracon AWSCR-CPLA 'Recommended Land Pattern' (datasheets/crystal/abracon/AWSCR-CPLA.pdf p.3; AWSCR-CPLB.pdf p.4 is the same drawing): outer pads 1.7, middle pad 1.5, 4.0 long, 2.5 pitch; equal to ECS-CTP Figure 2 (datasheets/crystal/ecs/ECS-CTP.pdf p.1). Hand check: x = -2.5, 0, +2.5; outer pads span 1.65..3.35 (the 1.2 terminal at the body end is 1.8..3.0), middle -0.75..0.75, gap 1.65-0.75 = 0.9. Pins 1 Input, 2 Ground, 3 Output left to right.
